title: Story destinations resolved into targets
hypothesis: Resolving the place the latest story line names into a concrete target from the game's own map table (MAY's "head back to the LAB" as PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB with its door in LITTLEROOT TOWN at (7,16); MOM's "He lives right next door" as PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE 1F with its door at (14,8)), and placing every story character the line names, stops models inventing destinations (run qwen36-gpu0_4caa read the LAB as in Rustboro at turn 273 and took its own house door for the lab; sh02 headed for the lab at turn 75 after "He lives right next door"), so more runs enter the rival's house, and return to the lab, in fewer turns.
notes: Uses the finals incumbent with dialogue-auto-advance-v1 ON, because story-destinations-v1 needs it (its page records are the story lines), character-presence-v1 ON, because the block places people from that readout line (without it every person reads "the readout does not say where"), and displayed-place-names-v1 ON, because the map table then names Littleroot's buildings by their sign text (PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE, PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB); without it "He lives" and "POKéMON LAB" find no map and are reported as not resolved. The bundle arm of bundle-v-control has all three on, the finals incumbent none. the candidate flips only story-destinations-v1. Activation: the first story line naming a place is MOM's "Well, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN." right after the truck (T48-T72 in the 2026-10-16 bundle runs). Primary RIVAL_HOUSE_ENTERED targets "He lives right next door"; the LAB line follows the Route 103 rival battle, so a design that measures it should start from a post-battle checkpoint. Approved by the operator 2026-10-16 for the bundle arm; the bundle definition (experiments/fixed/bundle-v-control.json) is owned elsewhere and not edited here. Provisional source.commit is this branch's RED commit; repin to the merge SHA with `just experiment-pin` when it lands.
